meta.name: eol-checklist
meta.description: Build a phase-gated EOL checklist sized to the sunset, with a named owner on every item. Use when the decision to retire is made and you need the operational plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定分阶段的产品退役清单,每项落实到人
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正负责某个产品或服务的退役,需要将收尾工作拆解并落实到具体负责人
copy.tagline_en: Create a phase-gated product retirement checklist with an owner for each item.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're managing a product sunset and need a structured operational plan with clear ownership.

howto.what: 生成按退役规模调整的、分阶段的 EOL 操作检查清单；每条项目都带动词和指定负责部门，并标出所属生命周期阶段；还会补充门控标准、假设和后续建议。
howto.when: 在退役决定已作出、需要制定执行计划时触发；若提供的信息不足，Claude 会先问最多三个问题再构建清单。

say.text: 为旧报表模块做个EOL清单，12月底停用，约400个账户。
say.note: Claude 会按标准规模生成分阶段、有负责人的清单。

say.text: 给硬件退役做重型检查清单，涉及服务合同和8家经销商。
say.note: Claude 会生成跨15个功能领域的完整清单。

say.text: 把这个功能下线清单做得轻量些，只留必要的几项。

howto.what_en: Generates a phase-gated EOL checklist sized to the sunset: every item has a verb, a phase, and a named owning function. Covers stranded areas like data, contracts, access, and money, plus gate criteria and assumptions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the retirement decision is made and an operational plan is needed. If details are missing, the skill asks up to three questions before building.

say_en.text: Build an EOL checklist for our legacy reporting module, shut down Dec 31, ~400 accounts.
say_en.note: Creates a standard-level checklist with phases and owners.

say_en.text: Heavy checklist for a hardware retirement, with service contracts and 8 resellers.
say_en.note: Produces a full cross-functional playbook across 15 areas.

say_en.text: Make this feature deprecation checklist lighter, only essential items.
say_en.note: Downgrades to Level 1 and notes what is dropped.
